create_multi_spkr_multi_style_dataset: create a MultiSpkrMultiStyleCodeDataset to load training audio files with speaker and style labels for speech resynthesis
sample_interval_from_dataset: sample a random interval of audio and code sequences from the MultiSpkrMultiStyleCodeDataset for training batches
create_inference_code_dataset: create an InferenceCodeDataset to load hubert codes and audio files for speech resynthesis inference with speaker and style control
load_audio_for_inference: load and normalize audio from a file path using InferenceCodeDataset get_audio method with resampling support
get_dataset_item: retrieve a dataset item containing features, audio tensor, filename, and mel spectrogram from MultiSpkrMultiStyleCodeDataset by index
